module: Small easter egg (Matrix reference): once loaded, the extension creates a "neo" console context, activates it and displays a mini text adventure. In this context, the "throttle" command answers "You crash. Game over."; other commands are ignored.
notes: The console context stays on 'neo' after loading; there is no exit code in this file.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension loads: disables console log timestamps, adds and activates the 'neo' context then displays the intro text.

onConsoleExecuteCommand.desc: Hook called when a command is run in the console. Ignores any context other than 'neo'; for the 'throttle' command, prints "You crash. Game over.".
